title: Kalshi true arbitrage
summary: 6 months of ATP/WTA and Challenger matches: after fees, every 'arb' was a stale or glitched quote. About $3 in total at one contract each.

title: Kalshi swing lock
summary: Buy one side, lock later when the other side is cheap: walk-forward test failed in 0 of 6 months, about −$0.32 per trade out of sample.

title: Early-round underdogs
summary: Betting every early-round underdog against a strong favourite at Kalshi's price lost about 16%. Underdogs are overpriced, not underpriced.

title: Seeds losing early
summary: 2010–2025: seeds lose about 30% of round 1–2 matches against unseeded players, about 2 points more than Elo expects, mostly against qualifiers. No odds in this data.

title: Elo model vs Kalshi
summary: Out-of-sample underdog bets picked by Elo lost 15% (108 bets). The market forecasts better than the model.

title: Penultimate-set winner
summary: The player who levels the match wins the decider about 54–55% of the time, but the price already says so: −1.2% ROI at the ask (1,359 bets).

title: Favourite flips during a match
summary: The pre-match favourite wins 66–72%; about half of matches see the favourite flip. Prices at each set end are well calibrated.

title: DraftKings underdogs, all tournaments
summary: Betting every early-round underdog at DraftKings' closing price returned −11.2% over 6,655 matches (Slams 2020–26, 1000s and 250/500s 2024–26). That is what DraftKings' margin predicts if Pinnacle's price is fair (−10.9%): its 5.2% margin falls mostly on the underdog. The Elo model failed the walk-forward test (−15%).

title: Line shopping: DraftKings vs Pinnacle
summary: Bet at DraftKings only when its odds beat Pinnacle's margin-free price: passes the walk-forward test (+6.4%, 379 bets), but rests on ~40 bets where the books disagreed by 5+ points, which look like stale DraftKings lines; +0.9% otherwise. Forward test on the Portfolio tab.

title: Better Elo vs the market
summary: Nine Elo upgrades (surface, margin of victory, fatigue, serve/return): the best cuts log loss by 0.010 vs our Elo but stays 0.020 worse than Pinnacle, and every variant loses 11–15% betting its edge at DraftKings.
